name: Rika-Playground
description: A web playground to test game spritesheets quickly without coding.

paragraphs: Rika Playground is a web-based sprite animation tool and playground designed for game developers and artists to quickly test and configure character animations. It allows you to upload sprite sheets, split them into frames, and preview them in a real-time game-like environment.
features: Sprite Sheet Splitting: Easily split uploaded sprite sheets by specifying columns and rows.
Frame Sequence Editing: Mask unwanted frames to create clean animation sequences.
Real-time Preview: Instantly see your animations in action with a controllable character.
Physics & Character Parameters: Adjust walk/run speeds, jump power, gravity, and character scale.
Background Selection: Choose from multiple backgrounds to test your character in different environments.
